verdict.rationale: Teams documents Incoming and Outgoing Webhooks and Connectors that let external services subscribe to and post messages/events to Teams channels (ms-teams-docs-12, ms-teams-docs-30, ms-teams-docs-36, ms-teams-docs-44), which is a real webhook subscription mechanism. However the evidence doesn't show Microsoft Graph's richer change-notification/subscription API for broader event types (message edits, membership changes, etc.), nor any AI-agent-specific webhook workflow. Missing for 10: explicit Graph webhook/subscription API documentation for arbitrary event types, and independent confirmation of reliability for programmatic/AI-native use cases.
